description: Debug-only bridge to the real PageExtractor JSWindowActor, for the PageExtractor Marker Inspector devtools panel.

functions.name: getText
functions.description: Calls the real PageExtractorParent#getText() for the given tab with the given GetTextOptions. Resolves to { result, markers, telemetry }: the real result, the PageExtractor profiler markers the call produced, and any newly recorded PageExtractor Glean events.

functions.name: getPageMetadata
functions.description: Calls the real PageExtractorParent#getPageMetadata() for the given tab. Resolves to { result, markers, telemetry }; see getText().

functions.name: waitForPageReady
functions.description: Calls the real PageExtractorParent#waitForPageReady() for the given tab. Resolves to { result, markers, telemetry }, where result is the status string; see getText().

functions.name: clearDebugOverlay
functions.description: Calls the real PageExtractorParent#clearDebugOverlay() for the given tab, removing the live-tracking highlight overlay a prior getText({ _debugLayout: true }) call left showing.

functions.name: getHoveredDebugBlock
functions.description: Calls the real PageExtractorParent#getHoveredDebugBlock() for the given tab: the block currently under the mouse in the debug overlay, or null.

functions.name: getHeadlessText
functions.description: Calls the real PageExtractorParent.getHeadlessExtractor() with the given URL and GetTextOptions, independent of any open tab. Resolves to { result, markers, telemetry }; see getText().
